assessment: The authors identify co-deletion of the mitochondrial AAA+ ATPase ATAD1 with the tumor suppressor PTEN as a factor modifying cancer prognosis, based on a new mechanism of increasing sensitivity to proteotoxic stress induced by proteasome inhibition. The authors also identify the mitochondrial E3 ubiquitin ligase MARCH5 as a gene whose deletion is synthetically lethal with ATAD1. These findings suggest that the use of proteasome-targeting agents may be useful in patients with tumors dually deleted for ATAD1 and PTEN. The study is based on convincing evidence and makes an innovative contribution to the understanding of the biology of tumors with 10q23 deletions.
